instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive components have explicit data-testid attributes formatted in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='upload-lab-report-input').
Use JS React components (.jsx/.js) matching existing project conventions.
Rely on existing Shadcn primitives in src/components/ui/ (sonner, dialog, table, tabs, dropdown-menu, select, calendar).
Ensure full multi-role RBAC representation (Patient, Doctor, Administrator) with WyshID generation and management.
Implement Sonner toasts for clear status feedback upon document OCR completion, Razorpay payments, and reminder dispatch.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic, centered, flat AI templates. Use dark accents, sharp subtle borders, and micro-animations.
Never apply transition: all. Use specific property transitions.
Use high contrast colors for readable text across light and dark modes.
Use lucide-react icons for all clinical indicators, navigation, and badges.
